title: Renew a bus operator accreditation
summary: This page provides instructions for accredited bus operators to renew their accreditation online.
intro: If you're an accredited bus operator you'll be notified:
who_can_apply: Accredited bus operators whose current accreditation has not expired.

how_to_steps.text: Enter the required details, and select 'OK'.
Select the payment list tab from the menu.
Select the 'apply' symbol next to the accreditation you wish to renew.Note: If your accreditation has expired the apply symbol will not appear.
Follow the prompts to complete your renewal application and make a payment.
Download and complete Application for Renewal of a Bus Operator Accreditation (3 years) – PDF.
Enter your credit card details, or your EFT receipt number.
Lodge your renewal application using the details on the form.

more_info.text: To ensure Transport for NSW (TfNSW) records are up to date, always notify them if any of your details change.
TfNSW will forward a payment receipt to you within 5 working days.

faqs.q: Who can renew their bus operator accreditation online?
faqs.a: You can renew online if your current accreditation has not expired.

faqs.q: What is required to renew the accreditation?
faqs.a: You need your MyRecords customer number, your operator number, your postcode, and a payment method (Visa or Mastercard only).

faqs.q: What happens if my accreditation has expired?
faqs.a: If your accreditation has expired, the 'apply' symbol will not appear during the online renewal process.
